Record Class SecurityDividendMetrics

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
grafioschtrader.reportviews.securitydividends.SecurityDividendMetrics
public record SecurityDividendMetrics(String currency, int dividendCount, LocalDate firstExDate, LocalDate lastExDate, Double lastAmount, LocalDate nextExDate, Double nextAmount, Double price, Double dividendTTM, Double yieldTTM, Integer paymentsPerYear, Double forwardYield, Double cagr1, Double cagr3, Double cagr5, Double cagr10, Integer yearsWithoutCut, Integer lastCutYear, Double lastCutPercent, Double chowder, Double payoutRatio, List<SecurityDividendMetrics.YearAmount> years, List<SecurityDividendMetrics.DateValue> yieldHistory, List<SecurityDividendMetrics.SplitMark> splits) extends Record
Dividend key figures of one security, derived from the shared dividend table and not from the distributions a tenant received. Every amount is split-adjusted and converted into the currency of the security with the exchange rate of the ex-date, so that it can be divided by the price of the security. A figure is null when its input is missing: no price, too short a history, a year without exchange rate, or a non-positive base.
